page: Microsoft Azure E4s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The configuration provides 4 vCPUs across 2 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8573C processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture with a maximum clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The hardware architecture incorporates hardware multithreading with 2 threads per core, backed by 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and a large 260 MB L3 cache pool. CPU features include instruction sets for vector and matrix operations such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX, alongside cryptographic accelerations like AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

System memory consists of 32.0 GB of RAM, establishing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include local disk storage, requiring external persistent network storage such as Premium Storage. Hardware accelerators are absent, with zero GPUs provisioned. Memory throughput tests demonstrate 36.52 GB/sec in large-block read operations and 25.66 GB/sec in large-block write operations, reflecting standard memory subsystem performance within this resource tier.

Benchmark evaluations indicate moderate single-core capabilities and constrained multi-core throughput, consistent with a two-core physical footprint. Geekbench scores reach 1664.0 in single-core tests and 3798.0 in multi-core metrics, while the PassMark CPU score records at 7386.87. Static web serving achieves a throughput of 7.52 GB/sec, and the system manages 5.69 million Redis SET operations per second. In machine learning workloads, prompt processing on a 7B parameter language model processes 32.42 tokens per second, but token generation is constrained at 4.61 tokens per second due to the lack of hardware acceleration.

The E4s_v6 is primarily suited for enterprise applications requiring elevated memory capacity without demanding high physical core counts. Typical deployments include in-memory caches, mid-sized relational database management systems, static web application tiers, and memory-bound ETL batch routines.
